name: linux-screencast-skills
description: Author and produce narrated screencast tutorials for AI tooling and any developer workflow, on a Linux host. screencast-storyboard scripts a tutorial: it reads the real docs and drafts an approved storyboard (transcript + timeline). screencast-tutorial-video produces the video: it records each scene with the right engine (VHS terminal, ffmpeg still-motion for native apps, headless Playwright for the browser, command cards) and assembles an OpenAI voice-over, captioned 1920x1080 MP4. Trigger phrases: "script a tutorial", "draft the transcript and timeline", "outline a screencast", "record the screencast", "produce the narrated MP4", "render the tutorial video". Linux host, OpenAI voice-over.
